terms.gloss: tear apart; of an enemy’s land or goods, lay waste, plunder, sack
evidence: Caes. BG 7.8.4: ab hostibus dīripī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: quī puerīs in epilogum prōductīs tālōs jēcit in medium, quōs illī dīripere coepērunt
phrases.english: who, when the children had been brought on for the peroration, threw knucklebones into the middle, and they began to scramble for them
